gen-comfortaa-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and open, with strokes cut to a single width. Comfortaa draws neon-tube strokes with stretched spacing up top, so Satoshi can stay at a modest size and its tall lowercase still reads clearly.
gen-comfortaa-switzer: A wide-open ring of a c gives Comfortaa its whole personality. Switzer brings wiry, tall-waisted letters, so a slightly smaller body size lets that height do the work without crowding.
gen-comfortaa-work-sans: Soft rings, stretched out: Comfortaa draws every heading stroke like glowing tube. And Work Sans gives the pair its best quality, a high mean line that sets tall modern text against the heading's moderate height.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-fs-bespoke-s: Bespoke Sans keeps sharp, refined letters with generous space where curves meet stems. And Alien Encounters, with its wide gaps and high x-height, adds a technological edge on top of that polish.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-epunda-sl: Alien Encounters stretches its letter pairs apart with a tall x-height and an otherworldly, technological feel. Epunda Slab brings a dignified serif with rounded tall lowercase and a visibly gaping c to ground it.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-fauna-one: Alien Encounters feels otherworldly and technological, with big gaps between letter pairs and a pronounced high x-height. Fauna One reads literary, its tall middle band and shallow ascenders easing along.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial, its big counters and unclosed curves staying wide. Yet nothing about it fights Alien Encounters, whose gappy, technological display letters feel a world away from this text serif.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-kadwa: Alien Encounters spaces its letters wide and tall, giving the heading an otherworldly, technological edge. And Kadwa, a text serif whose curves stay open-ended, gives that edge a classic editorial footing.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-noticia-t: Alien Encounters stretches its letter pairs apart, a tall x-height giving the heading an otherworldly, technological feel. Give Noticia Text a modest size; its lowercase fills the height.
gen-dafont-alien-encounters-gf-piazzolla: Otherworldly and technological, Alien Encounters spreads wide gaps between its letter pairs. And Piazzolla, a refined text serif, keeps its lowercase close to cap height and opens its e like a pried clasp.
